title: Assert session membership invalidation and fresh stamps through both rollback callers
outcome: Direct failure-path regressions prove that delegation follow-up parent rollback and remote delta rollback reject an earlier session runtime cut and preserve required mutation stamping.
acceptance: A regression drives the delegation follow-up parent rollback path and proves the prior session capture no longer validates and the restored parent carries a fresh mutation stamp while existing rollback behavior remains correct.
A regression drives remote delta rollback and proves the prior session capture is invalidated, including an equal-record or same-length restoration.
Relevant focused regressions pass on the exact changed input; the change follows the repository's standing review and gate rule.
